title: Time, snapshots and distributed reads
brief: Read related partitions at a safe common history. Compare logical timestamps, clock uncertainty and safe historical reads while distinguishing a past observation from authority for a current decision.

neighbouring_ownership.replicas: Owns single-copy read routing and read-your-write needs.
neighbouring_ownership.crdb-reads: Owns native isolation and follower-read choices.

title: Inside CockroachDB
brief: Trace SQL data through ordered keys, ranges, local storage and replicated ownership. Explain splits, leases and replica agreement with enough detail to see why a hotspot can persist as a cluster grows.

neighbouring_ownership.crdb-transactions: Owns native intents and commit/retry paths.
neighbouring_ownership.crdb-performance: Owns SQL/KV/network work and hot-range diagnosis.
neighbouring_ownership.crdb-operations: Owns health, identity and removal procedures.
neighbouring_ownership.distribution: Owns transferable replica-agreement concepts; this article develops their native range, Raft and lease application.

title: CockroachDB transactions and retries
brief: Relate intents and transaction state to atomic visibility, then handle native transaction retry and ambiguous-result paths for one logical purchase. Preserve the request identity and keep external work outside a replayed transaction.

neighbouring_ownership.transactions: Owns general invariant and isolation reasoning.
neighbouring_ownership.crdb-reads: Owns current versus historical read choices.
